title: Response-surface playback & percentile-preserving load harness for endpoints by model+region
creator: Jordan Lee
description: Build a reproducible playback and benchmarking harness that replays realistic traffic distributions (tokens/sec, prompt length, concurrency) and preserves p95/p99 characteristics per endpoint+model+region. Provide an exploratory dashboard (response-surface explorer) that lets SREs/Perf engineers compare baseline vs candidate runs, highlight slice-level regressions, and generate regression tickets automatically when statistical thresholds are exceeded.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can import production traffic samples and synthesize workloads such that p50/p95/p99 and token/sec distributions match within 5% of target slices
Playback runs can be executed against dedicated canary pools and hosted endpoints with parameterized region/model/endpoint selection
Dashboard shows side-by-side quantile curves (p50/p90/p95/p99) for baseline vs candidate and highlights slices with >10% p95 regression or >20% p99 regression
Automated regression detector creates a draft Linear ticket with prefilled diagnostics (diffed histograms, example requests, matching synthetic seed) when thresholds trigger
End-to-end test demonstrating detection for an injected latency regression (simulated kernel slowdown) with reproducible playback attached
comments: 2025-11-12 Jordan Lee: Created ticket after spike with SREs showed non-linear p99 increases when we multiplexed KV cache across cores. Goal: make regressions reproducible and triageable.

2025-11-14 Priya Iyer: Prototype harness can replay top-10 production sessions. Observed that naive per-request replay underestimates p99 due to missing session-level KV reuse. Need session-aware seeding.
2025-11-18 Marcus Chen: Implemented percentile-preserving sampler to preserve heavy-tailed prompt lengths. Verified tokens/sec histogram within 3% for sample routes.
2025-11-22 Ana Patel: UX for dashboard mockup submitted. Key ask: show 'regression heatmap' matrix of endpoint x model x region with clickable cells to open run diffs.
2025-11-26 Priya Iyer: Added statistical change-point detector using Kolmogorov–Smirnov plus bootstrapped confidence to reduce false positives during bursty traffic.
2025-11-28 Jordan Lee: Running a full-canary against dedicated pool tomorrow. If stable, will create the infer-bench PR to parameterize region routing and attach synthetic seeds to alerts.
decisions: Use session-aware playback seeds to preserve KV cache reuse characteristics (decision made 2025-11-14)
Adopt KS-test + bootstrap for slice-level significance to avoid alert noise from transient spikes (decision made 2025-11-26)
Persist synthetic seeds and run metadata in S3 for reproducibility and attach to regression tickets (decision made 2025-11-20)
Expose tokens/sec distribution and concurrent-requests as first-class playback parameters in the UI (decision made 2025-11-22)
